description: Diagnostic module that queries service_health table and identifies daemons with heartbeat age > their expected cycle threshold. Reads write_service via ws_query only. Produces a diagnostic report listing: (1) write_service stale at 5h27m, (2) mcp_scanner stale at 5h26m, (3) rug_pull_monitor stale at 637h37m, (4) anti_entropy stale at 5h27m, (5) wisdom_synthesiser stale at 5h27m. Does NOT attempt to restart anything — builder generates code, does not orchestrate services. Report is consumed by operator dashboard. Uses ws_query only, no direct DB access.
